description: How AiMarkdownRenderer treats an image in untrusted model markdown. Allow (the default) keeps today's behaviour (http/https images load; everything else degrades to the alt text). Block drops the image entirely. AltText renders the escaped alt instead of an img, so nothing is fetched.

members.name: Allow
members.description: Load a safe http/https image (the default). An unsafe source still degrades to its alt text.

members.name: Block
members.description: Drop the image entirely: no img and no alt text.

members.name: AltText
members.description: Render the escaped alt text instead of an img, so nothing is fetched.
